pairingMethod: Strictly ordered eight-point exported HTTP metric batches; timestamps/tags may repeat across complete batches. All samples retained, with full count/mean/p95 cross-checks against original summary; ambiguous within-batch reordering refused.

inferredActiveHttp.method: Sweep [request-end minus (blocked+duration), request-end) intervals; TLS/connect are subsets of blocked, not added again. Not complete iteration/VU occupancy; parsing/body validation and small gaps are omitted.

limitations: Diagnostic only; original drop/collector/normalization failures remain unchanged. No event-relative acceptance override.
Client waiting includes origin/edge/transit and cannot alone identify the slow server component.
CloudWatch minute aggregates and task samples are not per-request traces; running is not proof of target readiness.
Reconstructed request starts use k6 timings and wall-clock export timestamps, not a captured scheduler-arrival timestamp.
